title: GS1 Web Vocabulary
usedFor: Supply-chain identifiers (GTIN, GLN) and general product attributes. Candidate `gs1:` prefix for this project's JSON-LD context.
source: Third-party vocabulary survey. GS1's own publication has not been read.
finding: This project's JSON-LD context used to emit the prefix IRI, together with a `gtin -> gs1:gtin` term mapping, with no provenance record for either. That mapping was very likely correct — GS1 defines GTIN and we mean GTIN — but 'very likely correct' is the standard that put six wrong IDTA identifiers into a published crate, so both were removed on 2026-08-10 in favour of `gtin -> dpp:gtin`. The claim stays unadoptable until someone reads GS1's own definition and records it here.
nextStep: Read the GS1 Web Vocabulary's published definition of `gtin`, confirm the prefix IRI resolves, and establish the licence under which term labels may be redistributed. Then `gtin -> gs1:gtin` can be restored as a verified entry instead of an inherited assumption.
